title: Run workflow evaluations
summary: Runs one exact workflow case through an isolated host task, judges observable evidence without leaking the answer key, and records a scoped result.

intent.goal: Produce one reproducible case verdict whose source, runtime basis, observations, limitations, and artifact effects are explicit.
useWhen: A governed workflow case needs a baseline, regression, pressure, or invariant evaluation.
excludeWhen: The case itself needs authoring, the workflow is being promoted, or no isolated runtime is available.

procedure.outcome: Bind one exact case, workflow version, host, repository state, and containment policy.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never expose the answer key or drafting conversation to the worker.
Never let an evaluation worker publish, merge, or write to external providers.
Never record a pass from self-review or testimony without exact run evidence.
limitations: This normalized definition preserves inspectable intent only; it has no operator runtime, provider binding, effect authority, or behavior parity.
The fingerprinted legacy source remains canonical until a separate implemented and evidenced runtime migration removes that fallback.
